stops.note: named the high, cold, treeless plateau of the Andes
Quechua for high cold plateau; 'soroche', altitude sickness, is also called puna
stops.meaning: a high Andean plateau; also, altitude sickness

stops.note: borrowed into English geographical writing about South America
stops.meaning: a high, cold, arid plateau, especially in the Andes

current_meaning: a high, cold, arid plateau region of the central Andes
